cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've put your usual mug out. We can still have tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Still? Are you cross with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'm hoping you won't leave me cross.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry you feel that way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you try one where you're sorry about yourself? I'll keep the tea warm.

mechanism: A makes hospitality contingent on an approved apology while refusing to identify the offense for B.
confusable: Unlike demanding sorry neutrally, A must judge B's attempts from assumed superior authority.
comparison: A private coffee-table correction differs from a family photograph held up for spoken remorse.
seedUse: Canonical D03-a supplies hospitality and an inadequate apology; S01-a supplies granting permission for ordinary meal behavior.
